daily_report_items: Labcorp's August 20 bullish MACD transition strengthened through August 21, but refreshed Q2 valuation remains Hold/Watch and allocation-ineligible at USD 336.34; one precision-biology and healthcare-automation relationship review was queued.

evidence.claim: The unchanged SEC-hosted Q2 release reports USD 3.73 billion revenue, USD 4.99 adjusted EPS, and raised 2026 adjusted-EPS guidance of USD 18.10-18.55.

The Q2 Form 10-Q reports USD 141.8 million cash, USD 5.858 billion long-term debt, 80.9 million shares outstanding, USD 637.0 million first-half operating cash flow, and USD 252.6 million capital expenditure.

The August 11 Form 8-K discloses Megan Bailey's September 4 resignation and Brian Caveney's September 1 assumption of Biopharma Laboratory Services leadership, adding execution-monitoring risk without changing guidance.
The August 17 Form 8-K schedules a September 10 Investor Day on strategy, capital deployment, and long-term financial outlook but provides no targets to incorporate yet.
The SEC submissions index showed no later substantive periodic or current filing after the August 17 notice through the August 21 research cutoff.

Canonical alert data records an August 20 MACD cross above signal after a 4.23% rise from July 23 to August 20; the latest canonical August 21 mark was USD 336.3399963378906 with positive MACD, RSI 76.04, and an above-upper-band state.

Deterministic schema-v2 assessment derives a USD 311.8625 probability-weighted fair value, -7.2776% expected return, -5.4582% confidence-adjusted expected return, USD 249.22 buy-below price, Hold/Watch status, and allocation ineligibility at the fresh mark.

summary: Completed one alert-driven Labcorp security review. The August 20 MACD cross was a genuine bullish momentum transition and the August 21 close reached USD 336.34, but refreshed Q2 and subsequent SEC evidence did not justify raising the unchanged USD 253.40/USD 311.525/USD 371.00 bear/base/bull values. Deterministic assessment remains Hold/Watch and allocation-ineligible because expected and base returns, downside payoff, margin of safety, and the accepted-relationship gate fail. Updated the security page and structured state, registered five current primary-source checks, and queued one dependent review of the plausible precision-biology and healthcare-automation relationship; no strategy work was justified.
